title: Find largest installed packages by size
summary: Identify which installed packages take up the most disk space. This helps when you need to free up space on your hard drive.

steps.explain: List all installed packages and their individual sizes, sorted from smallest to largest.
steps.cmd: LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 pacman -Qi | awk '/^Name/{name=$3} /^Installed Size/{print $4$5, name}' | LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 sort -h
